code_findings.title: Owner can front-run claim() to redirect entire payment to attacker-controlled nudge address (slippage check does not cover split)
code_findings.description: setNudgeAddress() and setNudgeSplit() are unguarded onlyOwner setters with no timelock and no per-claim authorization. A malicious or MEV-aware owner can observe a pending claim() and atomically set nudgeSplit=100 with an owner address. The slippage parameter minRewardTokenSupplied only checks actualPayment >= min, NOT the split distribution. Result: claimer pays full amount, NFT burned, strategies drained, but 100% of payment routes to owner instead of Phlimbo.
code_findings.preconditions: Owner is malicious or compromised (or owner accidentally misconfigures).
code_findings.suggested_fix: Add minPhlimboAmount slippage parameter, or cap nudgeSplit (e.g., to 30), or impose timelock on changes.

code_findings.title: claim() does not call phlimbo.collectReward when nudgeSplit==100
code_findings.description: When nudgeSplit==100, phlimboAmount=0, so collectReward(0) is never called. Phlimbo accounting hooks may be bypassed.
code_findings.suggested_fix: Document or always call collectReward(0).

code_findings.title: claim() denormalization can compute actualPayment==0 while still draining strategies, allowing free claims of small yield
code_findings.description: After totalNormalizedYield>0 check, claimerPayment = totalNormalizedYield * (10000 - discountRate) / 10000, then actualPayment = _denormalizeAmount(claimerPayment, rewardToken). With low-decimal reward token (USDC=6) and tiny 18-dec yield, actualPayment can floor to 0. Strategies are still drained to claimer; no actualPayment==0 guard. Free yield extraction up to NFT supply.
code_findings.preconditions: rewardToken decimals < 18 AND strategy yield small enough to truncate.
code_findings.suggested_fix: Revert if actualPayment==0 before withdrawing from strategies.

code_findings.title: NFT burn before yield withdrawal
code_findings.description: NFT burn occurs at start of claim(); reverts roll back the burn so this is mostly cosmetic. Minor griefing edge cases.
code_findings.suggested_fix: Move NFT validate/burn after totalNormalizedYield computed.

code_findings.title: Cross-contract reentrancy via nudge address with hookable rewardToken
code_findings.description: nudge is an arbitrary owner-set address receiving reward tokens BEFORE phlimbo.collectReward. nonReentrant blocks claim() re-entry but not cross-contract callbacks if rewardToken has hooks (ERC777, ERC1363). With standard USDC: low risk. setRewardToken does not enforce hookless tokens.
code_findings.preconditions: rewardToken has transfer hooks AND nudge is attacker-controlled.
code_findings.suggested_fix: Reorder: phlimbo.collectReward first, then nudge transfer (CEI). Or guard rewardToken type.

code_findings.title: No validation that nudge != phlimbo, address(this), minterAddress
code_findings.description: setNudgeAddress accepts any address. Aliasing to phlimbo, address(this), or minter causes silent misallocation. address(this) is particularly bad — no rescue function exists.
code_findings.suggested_fix: Revert if _nudge in {address(this), phlimbo, minterAddress, nftMinter, rewardToken}. Add rescueToken function.

code_findings.title: approvePhlimbo allows owner to revoke phlimbo allowance, DoSing claims
code_findings.description: If phlimbo.collectReward pulls via transferFrom, owner setting approval to 0 DoSes claim flow. Tx reverts so no fund loss; pure liveness.
code_findings.suggested_fix: Push to phlimbo via safeTransfer instead of relying on pull approval.

code_findings.title: setRewardToken emits no event; missing two-step pattern across config setters
code_findings.description: setRewardToken emits no event (asymmetric vs other setters). Old reward token's allowance to phlimbo not zeroed during rotation.
code_findings.suggested_fix: Emit RewardTokenUpdated; clear old allowance on rotation.

code_findings.title: Slippage protection only one-sided; owner-side updates can grief in-flight claims
code_findings.description: Owner can pause tokens or change exchange rates between calculateClaimAmount() and claim(), causing actualPayment to swing. Only minRewardTokenSupplied (lower bound) protected; no upper bound.
code_findings.suggested_fix: Add max-payment slippage parameter.

code_findings.title: removeYieldStrategy is O(n) — gas concern only
code_findings.description: Linear scan; bounded by owner-managed strategy count. Defensive note only.
code_findings.suggested_fix: Track index in mapping for O(1) removal.

code_findings.title: NFT burn assumes NFTMinter honors burn semantics
code_findings.description: _validateAndBurnNFT trusts NFTMinter to actually decrement balance. Bug or malicious minter could let user re-claim without burn.
code_findings.suggested_fix: Compare balanceOf before/after burn, or require NFTMinter enforces invariant.

code_findings.title: canClaim() unbounded loop with external balanceOf calls
code_findings.description: Iterates from i=1 to nextIndex(). Bot reliability degraded for large NFTMinter; no fund risk.
code_findings.suggested_fix: Paginate or accept index parameter.

code_findings.title: No event for nudge/phlimbo split amounts
code_findings.description: RewardsClaimed reports total but not nudgeAmount/phlimboAmount. Off-chain attribution requires trace inspection.
code_findings.suggested_fix: Emit NudgePayment and PhlimboPayment events.

code_findings.title: Independent setters for nudge/nudgeSplit allow inconsistent state DoS
code_findings.description: setNudgeSplit(50) while nudge==address(0) DoSes claim() until owner fixes. setNudgeAddress(0) when nudgeSplit>0 also breaks invariant.
code_findings.suggested_fix: Atomic setNudgeConfig(addr, split), or setters revert on inconsistency.

code_findings.title: Unconfigured token decimals/exchangeRate fall back silently — covered in known issues
code_findings.description: Documented known issue (#8). Skip.
code_findings.suggested_fix: Already known.

code_findings.title: Single misbehaving strategy reverts entire claim()
code_findings.description: No try/catch around withdrawFrom. Any failing strategy DoSes the whole claim until owner removes/pauses it.
code_findings.suggested_fix: Wrap in try/catch; emit StrategyFailed; continue.

code_findings.title: Fee-on-transfer behavior in strategy withdrawals miscounts received yield
code_findings.description: User billed for `yield` but receives `yield - fee`. Fee-on-transfer documented OOS; strategy-level fees not.
code_findings.suggested_fix: Use balance-delta accounting for received yield.

code_findings.title: setPhlimbo does not zero old phlimbo's allowance on rewardToken
code_findings.description: Old phlimbo retains rewardToken approval after rotation. Bounded by trusted phlimbo and transient SYA balance.
code_findings.suggested_fix: Zero old phlimbo's allowance in setPhlimbo.

code_findings.title: setDiscountRate allows 100% discount, enabling free strategy drain
code_findings.description: rate==10000 allowed; produces actualPayment==0; combined with absent zero-payment guard (code-03), any NFT holder drains strategies for free.
code_findings.suggested_fix: Require rate < 10000; guard actualPayment > 0.

code_findings.title: Admin setters not gated by whenNotPaused — config drift during pause
code_findings.description: Owner can mutate config while paused. Next claim post-unpause uses new config without warning. Amplifies front-running risk.
code_findings.suggested_fix: Gate config setters with whenNotPaused or add settling delay.

econ_findings.title: Slippage parameter does not protect claimer against adverse discount-rate changes
econ_findings.description: minRewardTokenSupplied checks actualPayment >= min (lower bound) — but bot's risk is OVERPAYING, not underpaying. If owner reduces discount rate or raises exchange rate between simulation and inclusion, claimer pays more than expected for the same yield. Slippage check passes (actualPayment > min), claimer is forced into unprofitable trade.
econ_findings.attack_path: Bot quotes 14.7 USDC for 15 USD yield at 2% discount, sets min=14.7. Owner sets discount=0; actualPayment becomes 15. Check passes; claimer pays full price for 0 profit.
econ_findings.suggested_fix: Add maxRewardTokenPaid (upper bound) AND/OR minNormalizedYieldReceived; or rename current parameter.

econ_findings.title: Yield withdrawn to claimer BEFORE payment collected
econ_findings.description: strategy.withdrawFrom transfers yield to msg.sender (line 480) before safeTransferFrom payment (line 504). FOT rewardToken would brick claim. Callback-token strategies allow intra-tx external manipulation.
econ_findings.suggested_fix: Move payment collection BEFORE strategy withdrawal loop (CEI).

econ_findings.title: Nudge mechanism allows owner to redirect 100% of claim revenue with no cap
econ_findings.description: setNudgeAddress accepts any address; setNudgeSplit accepts up to 100. Owner can synchronously redirect all claim revenue to an EOA. No cap, timelock, or beneficiary lock. Expands trust model beyond documented assumptions.
econ_findings.attack_path: Owner key compromise → setNudgeAddress(attacker); setNudgeSplit(100) → all future claim revenue diverted.
econ_findings.suggested_fix: Cap nudgeSplit (e.g., 20-30%); require nudge has code; add timelock; pauser-callable emergency reset.

econ_findings.title: Owner front-running pending claim() via nudgeSplit
econ_findings.description: Mempool-watching owner can set nudgeSplit=100 + nudgeAddress=ownerEOA before claim() inclusion. Slippage doesn't check distribution. Per-claim revenue grab.
econ_findings.suggested_fix: Add 1-block delay on nudge changes, or per-claim expectedPhlimboShare parameter.

econ_findings.title: Nudge as 'soft pause' bypasses dual-unpause governance
econ_findings.description: Behodler3 dual-unpause design intends bilateral unpause to prevent owner-only reward denial. Setting nudgeSplit=100 to a burn address achieves permanent rewards denial unilaterally. Pauser has no nudge authority.

econ_findings.title: Compound precision loss in normalize/denormalize round-trip
econ_findings.description: Per-strategy normalization, then aggregate denormalization, rounds DOWN systematically — claimer-favored. Dust per-call.
econ_findings.suggested_fix: Document; or per-strategy denormalize and reconcile.

econ_findings.title: Strategy removal strands accumulated yield
econ_findings.description: removeYieldStrategy doesn't require zero pending yield. Phlimbo loses that yield permanently. Re-addition produces windfall to first claimer.
econ_findings.suggested_fix: Require zero pending yield (or force-claim) before removal.

econ_findings.title: calculateClaimAmount inconsistent with claim under owner-state changes
econ_findings.description: View matches claim() at fixed state but state is fluid (pause, exchange rate, discount). Compounds econ-01.

econ_findings.title: Strategy yield computation trusts external balance reads (flash-loan donation)
econ_findings.description: yield = totalBalance - principal. If strategy's balance is inflatable via flash-loan donation, attacker drains real reserves at discount. SYA-layer makes no defensive bound. Strategies are OOS but SYA's defensive gap is in-scope.
econ_findings.suggested_fix: Per-claim yield cap; or TWAP yield.

econ_findings.title: Token-pause yield backlog captured by single MEV claimer on unpause
econ_findings.description: MEV bot back-runs unpauseToken to capture entire pause-window yield at standard discount.
econ_findings.suggested_fix: Delayed unpause, or metered backlog release.

econ_findings.title: NFT burn before yield availability check — gas griefing
econ_findings.description: Same family as code-04. NFT burn rolls back on revert; gas griefing only.
econ_findings.suggested_fix: Move NFT burn after yield computation.

econ_findings.title: setRewardToken mid-life leaves stale tokenConfig assumptions
econ_findings.description: Owner switching reward token changes denormalization base. Front-running pending claim with setRewardToken DoSes claim or shifts payment unit.
econ_findings.suggested_fix: Require new token has tokenConfig; two-step migration; expectedRewardToken in claim().

econ_findings.title: Single strategy revert bricks all-strategy claim()
econ_findings.description: Same family as code-16. Liveness loss across all strategies if any one strategy fails.

known_issues: Dual-unpause mechanism (owner AND pauser can unpause) - intentional Behodler3 pattern
Decimal normalization to 18 decimals internally - documented design
Circular reference between Phlimbo and StableYieldAccumulator - documented deployment order
No oracles/AMMs; assumed 1:1 stablecoin exchange rates (owner-adjustable for permanent depegs)
Owner trust assumptions (registering strategies, exchange rates, pausing) - operational risk
Pauser trust assumptions - designated pauser can pause operations
External yield strategy behavior assumptions - out of scope
Token config with zero decimals/exchange rate defaults to 18 decimals and 1:1 rate
